title: Last Forever (1)
novel:
Ted sat his children down on the couch and told them he was finally [[finishing|finish]] the story. He had been telling them the story of how he met their mother for many years. Now, the tale was reaching its [[end|end]].

Ted [[described|describe]] the key moments that followed Barney and Robin's wedding. He told them about the day Barney and Robin got divorced, three years after the wedding. It was a [[painful|painful]] moment for everyone. Barney returned to his old lifestyle, while Robin threw herself into her career.

Ted [[revealed|reveal]] that he and the Mother, Tracy, finally met at the Farhampton train station after the wedding. Their first conversation was about a yellow umbrella. It was a moment of pure [[destiny|destiny]]. They fell in love quickly and deeply.

The story jumped forward in time. Ted and Tracy dated for years before he finally [[proposed|propose]] to her. They had two children together. But Ted's voice grew quiet as he approached the most difficult part of the story.

He told his children that their mother had been sick. She had fought [[bravely|bravely]] against her illness, but in the end, she [[passed away|pass away]]. The room fell silent. Ted wiped a tear from his eye.

His daughter asked why he was telling them this story now. Ted hesitated. He said that every story has a [[beginning|beginning]] and an end. He wanted them to understand that love was the most [[powerful|powerful]] force in the world, even when it ended in [[sorrow|sorrow]].

The children looked at their father with new [[understanding|understanding]]. They realized that this story was not just about how their parents met. It was about a [[lifetime|lifetime]] of love, loss, and the [[memories|memory]] that remained.

end.en: All good things come to an end.

destiny.en: It was destiny that brought them together.

propose.en: He proposed to her under the stars.

pass away.en: Her grandfather passed away last year.
